name: mapping_renegotiate
description: A mid-capture code renegotiation must not stop decoding: open the capture screen under the synthetic camera, switch the alphabet (configure → new code book + restamped epoch, as the alphabet planner does on a slow phone) before anything has decoded, then require every LED id. Regression for the hue code v2 android_journeys failure, where the synthetic scene kept the old code book and decoded 0 ids. Needs a connected device.
